messages:
Dana Brooks: Quick update on Catalyze case study — interview done, transcript and raw audio in Drive. Need customer quote sign-off, legal review for benchmark language, and asset prep. Target publish 2026-08-10 09:00 PT (embargo).
Eli Vargas: I'll take quote approvals. Draft hero quote from call: "Redwood improved our inference latency and let us ship the new summary feature faster." Sending to Catalyze now.
Sam Knight: Creative ETA 72h after assets final. Will produce hero image, three social tiles, a 30s social clip and 2min highlight. Also need logo usage permission from the customer.
Dana Brooks: Customer asked to avoid absolutes. Proposed rewrite sent to them: "Redwood reduced our median inference latency and helped us launch the summary feature sooner." Also asked Catalyze to confirm permission to publish the benchmark numbers.
LegalBot: Initiated review. We require benchmark phrasing like "approximately X%" and a citation to internal test ID C-2026-215. Also request redaction of any PII in transcript. Please upload signed release to legal repo.
Maya Singh: Ops note: I'll configure HubSpot form to tag inbound leads with "catalyze-case-2026" and route to AE queue. Recommend gating a one-pager to improve lead quality.
Eli Vargas: Catalyze approved the revised quote and signed the release. They OK'd a short webinar spot on 2026-08-17 for a product demo (10-15 mins). Uploaded signed release to shared drive.
LegalBot: Verified release and redactions done. Uploaded to legal repo: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/catalyze/RELEASE_1809999120.pdf. Legal approves publish after embargo and customer preview.
Sam Knight: Noted. I'll avoid competitor mentions and follow the legal phrasing for the benchmark. Need the exact numbers from eng to write the methodology blurb.
Dana Brooks: Engineering reports ~2.1x median latency improvement on the benchmark workload and ~25% lower token cost; marketing phrasing: "approximately 2.1x median latency improvement" and "approximately 25% lower cost per token". Cite C-2026-215.
Maya Singh: HubSpot form routing configured, UTMs set, gating option created for the one-pager. I'll also wire a campaign to tag leads for AE+CS follow-up.
Eli Vargas: Landing draft will be posted here for Catalyze preview on Mon 08/03. Sophia will deliver final assets by Fri 08/07.
Sam Knight: I'll export final hero + clips after legal confirmation. ETA for final assets: Fri 08/07 EOD.
Dana Brooks: Great. Final checklist: customer preview link, signed release (done), legal approval (done), creative exports (pending), HubSpot routing (done). We'll reconvene here for final go/no-go before embargo. :white_check_mark:
